benchmark_results: Baseline (03/05): 4x A100-equivalent pool, model: llama3-70b-instruct-fp16 -> median generation latency (512 tokens) p50=36ms, p95=160ms, p99=420ms (note: caching enabled for prefix hits).
Throughput: sustained 220 requests/sec at 512-token prompts with batching tuned to 32; token/sec ~9.6k under test workload.
Quantized variant (8-bit dynamic): p50 +12ms, p95 +40ms, observed 4% drop in rerank NDCG on evaluation set for product search queries.
Soak (03/09 ongoing): no OOMs after first 12h, observed two transient CPU spikes correlating with autoscaler events — investigating autoscaler thresholds.
latency_slos: Customer target: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms, p99 < 350-400ms for 512-token rerank calls during steady-state; stricter targets for checkout scoring (p99 < 250ms).
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial commit ask: 8 x A100-40GB equivalent for Dedicated pool (config to support autoscale + burst to 12 during promos). Plan to reserve for 12 months with quarterly throughput reviews.
negotiation_notes: Emerald Crest pushing for financial credits if p99 > SLA more than 3x in a month. They want a clear definition of 'downtime' vs 'degraded performance' and a tested fallback route to hosted-compatible smaller model during capacity events.
